title: Maybelline New York updates its 35-year-old ‘Maybe she’s born with it’ tagline
summary: The L’Oréal-owned make-up brand has revamped its famous tagline, which first debuted in 1991, to reflect the brand’s “next chapter” and how women see beauty today. Sandrine Jolly, Global Brand President of Maybelline New York, reveals the new tagline and campaign with Miley Cyrus below
